pair.name: Pair
pair.description: Pair the controller as an additional remote. Shades: P2 under the battery cover, wait 2 s, P2 again, then Pair. Roof and light: power-cycle the motor, then Pair within 10 s; the controller sends the code-key signal for about 5 s and STOP for about 5 s. Watch the response and test control; there is no motor feedback.
